What to include in your message

  • The game name and version
  • Your device model and operating system
  • Steps that lead to the issue
  • A screenshot without personal information

Keep your details to yourself.

Never send passwords or card details. A store order number is enough for purchase support. Refunds are handled by the store where you made the purchase.
